title: [Technical] Establish repeatable CI and release-quality baseline
body:
## Objective
Make the current Expo SDK 57 baseline reproducible before remote services are added.

## Scope
- Commit and enforce `package-lock.json` with `npm ci`.
- Run dependency check, Expo Doctor, lint, typecheck, and checkout guards in CI.
- Add smoke-test evidence for all drawer routes and the direct-vote flow.
- Define supported Android/iOS versions and test large text and short screens.

## Acceptance criteria
- A clean clone passes all checks using the pinned Node/npm toolchain.
- CI fails on dependency drift or an uncommitted lockfile change.
- Manual smoke-test evidence is attached.

## Out of scope
Backend connectivity and product data.

title: [Technical] Audit and harden the Supabase migration baseline
body:
## Objective
Turn the existing draft SQL into a trustworthy pre-production baseline.

## Scope
- Apply all migrations from zero in disposable local Supabase.
- Review table purpose, constraints, UTC boundaries, `security definer` search paths, grants, and revocations.
- Enable RLS on every exposed table and add SQL access tests.
- Test zero votes, ties, duplicate votes, disabled questions, finalization, and missing records.
- If no shared environment has consumed these migrations, squash them into one clean baseline; otherwise add forward-only fixes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Local reset succeeds from an empty database.
- Automated tests prove active results cannot leak and finalized votes cannot mutate.
- The migration strategy is documented.

## Depends on
T01.

title: [Technical] Add Supabase read-only health connectivity
body:
## Objective
Prove safe mobile-to-Supabase connectivity before reading or writing product data.

## Scope
- Add the current compatible Supabase JavaScript client.
- Configure `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and the publishable key only.
- Add typed configuration validation and a harmless health endpoint/query.
- Render missing-config, connecting, success, and failure states.

## Security constraints
Never embed a secret/service-role key, database password, FCM credential, or translation API key.

## Acceptance criteria
- Android and iOS development builds connect successfully.
- Missing or invalid configuration fails clearly.
- Bundle inspection finds no server secrets.

## Depends on
T02.

title: [Technical] Replace the hardcoded Today question with a read-only query
body:
## Objective
Load the active UTC daily question from Supabase without enabling voting writes.

## Scope
- Add a typed API module, TanStack Query provider, and `useTodayQuestion` hook.
- Implement loading, empty, error, retry, and cached-last-known states.
- Validate UTC rollover and refresh behavior.

## Acceptance criteria
- Updating the active question in Supabase updates the app without rebuilding.
- No vote mutation is introduced.
- Date rollover tests pass.

## Depends on
T03.

title: [Technical] Connect paginated finalized Past Results with caching
body:
## Objective
Replace preview records with all public finalized questions.

## Scope
- Add one paginated result summary endpoint/query; avoid N+1 card requests.
- Return question, asked date, finalization time, YES/NO percentages, result, and vote count.
- Add pagination, pull-to-refresh, errors, empty state, and persisted cache.
- Join personal vote markers locally; do not expose personal history through the public RPC.

## Acceptance criteria
- Active/unfinalized results never appear.
- Results are available regardless of participation.
- Previously loaded pages remain readable offline.

## Depends on
T04.

title: [Technical] Implement an idempotent secure vote write path
body:
## Objective
Accept one immutable server-confirmed vote per installation and question.

## Scope
- Use a secured Edge Function or RPC to validate question status, UTC window, and YES/NO input.
- Issue and verify an installation credential; do not trust arbitrary client device IDs or fingerprints.
- Enforce uniqueness, rate limits, and idempotency/replay handling server-side.
- Derive network abuse signals server-side and return an immutable vote receipt ID.

## Acceptance criteria
- Duplicate, late, malformed, and replayed requests are rejected deterministically.
- A retry returns the original accepted receipt rather than adding a vote.
- The UI records only server-confirmed votes.

## Depends on
T04 and T02.

title: [Technical] Add durable local cache and offline behavior
body:
## Objective
Allow offline browsing without compromising vote integrity.

## Scope
- Monitor connectivity and show a non-blocking offline state.
- Persist finalized-result pages and server-confirmed vote receipts.
- Disable voting offline with clear copy.
- Never queue a vote for later upload.

## Acceptance criteria
- Airplane mode can browse previously downloaded results/history.
- Offline voting cannot appear accepted.
- Cache migration and corruption recovery are tested.

## Depends on
T05 and T06.

title: [Technical] Add optional email account and canonical history merge
body:
## Objective
Let users preserve answered-question history across devices without making signup mandatory.

## Scope
- Add verified email OTP/magic-link authentication; names remain optional.
- Link the authenticated account using `auth.uid()`, never a client-supplied account ID.
- Claim server-known installation votes transactionally and idempotently.
- Preserve the established account vote on duplicate-question conflicts.
- Add account-only history RLS, audit records, logout cache cleanup, and deletion/anonymization flow.

## Acceptance criteria
- Device A history restores on Device B after verified login.
- Retried/interrupted merges do not duplicate or overwrite votes.
- Anonymous use remains fully functional.

## Depends on
T06 and T07.

title: [Technical] Implement tested My Pulse calculations
body:
## Objective
Replace the placeholder with trustworthy personal agreement insights.

## Scope
- Calculate answered count, agreement/disagreement counts and percentages from canonical history and finalized results.
- Require at least 10 eligible finalized answers.
- Define ties explicitly; recommended: exclude ties from agreement denominator and show them separately.
- Add unit tests for 0, 9, 10+, ties, missing results, and merged histories.

## Acceptance criteria
- Metrics are deterministic and explainable.
- No insight appears before the threshold.
- UI clearly states denominator and tie behavior.

## Depends on
T08 and T05.

title: [Technical] Implement Brewing Questions submissions and moderation safely
body:
## Objective
Deliver community question submission and selection without automating abuse.

## Scope
- Add approved-submission read list, one daily upvote, weekly submission limit, and immutable submissions.
- Add moderation states, duplicate links, veto/disable controls, audit trail, and authenticated admin panel.
- Define calendar-week versus rolling-seven-day semantics.
- Add automatic tomorrow selection only after moderation and rollback work.

## Acceptance criteria
- Duplicate/abusive/vetoed submissions cannot be selected.
- Limits are enforced server-side under concurrency.
- Admin override is audited.

## Depends on
T06 and T08.

title: [Technical] Introduce server-side translation workflow incrementally
body:
## Objective
Translate questions without exposing provider keys or paying two providers by default.

## Scope
- Start with one server-side provider, preserve original text, cache by question/language/version, and support admin correction.
- Capture quality and cost metrics.
- Run a measured comparison before adding a second provider or automated evaluator.

## Acceptance criteria
- No translation key appears in the mobile bundle.
- Original language is always viewable.
- Failed translation falls back safely.
- A documented experiment determines whether dual providers are justified.

## Depends on
T10.

title: [Technical] Add FCM HTTP v1 daily notification delivery
body:
## Objective
Notify opted-in users when the daily question goes live at 12:00 UTC.

## Scope
- Add permission UX and server-side token registration/rotation/removal.
- Send through FCM HTTP v1 using service-account OAuth, never a legacy server key.
- Schedule at 12:00 UTC and monitor delivery failures/invalid tokens.
- Deep-link into Today and support opt-out.

## Acceptance criteria
- Test devices receive one notification per daily publication.
- Invalid tokens are retired.
- Credentials remain server-side.
- Delivery is observable and retry-safe.

## Depends on
T06; do not launch until the core daily loop is reliable.

title: [Feature] Show total vote count with every finalized result
body:
## User outcome
A result shows not only percentages but how many accepted votes produced it.

## Requirements
- Display a localized count such as `128,421 votes` on result detail/cards where space permits.
- Count only accepted votes included at finalization.
- Define zero-vote and tie presentation.
- Do not imply statistical representativeness; label the population as PULSE voters.

## Acceptance criteria
- Count matches the finalized server aggregate.
- Large counts use locale-aware formatting.
- Accessibility reads result, percentages, and count coherently.

## Depends on
T05.

title: [Research] Define minimum sample and reliability rule for any future country result
body:
## Decision needed
What minimum evidence is required before showing a country-level split?

## Constraints
Country reporting is deferred and must not be inferred from phone code, locale, SIM, or IP. A future implementation requires optional self-declared country, privacy review, anti-switching controls, and honest “PULSE voters in X” labels.

## Research scope
- Choose a minimum sample threshold and whether it varies with margin of error.
- Define copy: `Not enough votes for a reliable country result.`
- Suppress percentages and winner below threshold.
- Evaluate small-cohort privacy and manipulation risk.
- Require sample size and unweighted-sample disclosure above threshold.

## Acceptance criteria
A written product/statistical/privacy decision is approved before country data or UI is implemented.

## Out of scope
Implementing country collection now.

title: [Feature] Gate yesterday’s landing-page reveal while keeping Past Results public
body:
## User outcome
A returning voter sees yesterday’s result on Today; a non-voter gets warm, non-punitive copy directing them to Past Results, where all finalized questions remain public.

## Copy direction
Avoid guilt or false assumptions such as “you were busy.” Recommended tone: `We missed your voice yesterday. Explore the result in Past Results.`

## Rules
- Landing-page reveal checks canonical/local participation for yesterday’s question.
- Non-voters do not receive the inline reveal, but can open the same public result in Past Results.
- Account/device changes must not incorrectly hide a known account vote after sync.
- Accessibility and deep links must still reach Past Results.

## Acceptance criteria
Voter and non-voter paths are tested, including logged-out, restored-account, missing-cache, and offline states.

## Depends on
T05, T07, and eventually T08 for cross-device accuracy.

title: [Feature] Show result publication countdown in the device timezone
body:
## User outcome
Everyday UI explains result timing locally: `Results in 6h 12m` or `Results tomorrow at 1:00 PM`.

## Requirements
- Treat 12:00 UTC as the canonical server boundary.
- Derive display from a server timestamp, not a hardcoded 24-hour client timer.
- Use device locale/timezone and handle DST, timezone changes, clock skew, backgrounding, and minute rollover.
- An information screen may explain that the global question changes daily at 12:00 UTC.

## Acceptance criteria
Tests cover UTC± offsets, half-hour/quarter-hour zones, DST transitions, device timezone changes, and a stale client clock.

## Depends on
T04.

title: [Feature] Implement the post-vote counted receipt and live countdown
body:
## User outcome
After server acceptance, show:

`Vote counted`  
`You voted YES`  
`Results in 18h 41m`  
`Come back when tomorrow’s question goes live.`

## Requirements
- Show only after the server returns an accepted immutable receipt.
- Use the canonical publication timestamp and the shared localized countdown component.
- Persist the receipt across restarts.
- Distinguish pending, rejected, duplicate/idempotent success, and accepted states.

## Acceptance criteria
The receipt survives restart, never appears for a rejected/offline vote, and remains accessible at large text sizes.

## Depends on
T06, T07, and F04.

title: [Feature] Notify a submitter when their question is selected
body:
## User outcome
A submitter can opt to learn that their question was selected for the daily Pulse.

## Identity decision
A device signature is not a communication channel and is not durable after reinstall. Use:
- push notification to an opted-in installation token for anonymous users; and/or
- verified email for users who voluntarily link an account.
Do not require email merely to submit a question.

## Requirements
- Store submission ownership as installation identity plus optional account ID—not raw email on the submission.
- Record a durable `selected` event and send each configured channel idempotently.
- Define behavior after reinstall, logout, token rotation, account merge, duplicate marking, veto, and selection reversal.
- Keep notification preferences and unsubscribe controls.

## Acceptance criteria
The submitter receives at most one notification per selection event through opted-in channels; no device fingerprint is treated as an address.

## Depends on
T10, T12, and optionally T08.
